name: Hitozuma Shoutengai ~ Urimono wa Wa-ta-shi
original_name: 人妻商店街～売り物はわ・た・し
source:
Motoya is a university student.

One night, when he walks around a shopping arcade, a coffee shop is still open... He goes inside to drink hot milk and finds an owner, Yumie, being drunk. They enjoy drinking together, but she suddenly starts masturbating...!

[From ErogeShop]
